digest.component_or_area: LLM gate telemetry and usage recording
propositions: LLM gate runs produce no durable record of per-run request or tool-call counts, preventing operators from tuning gates or distinguishing loops from genuine breadth exploration
failure_usage() computes loop-vs-breadth signal (tool_calls, tool_calls_distinct, max_consecutive_repeat) then discards it at the record() write, keeping only token counters in the durable row
success-path runs never compute the tool-call shape at all; structured_run._extract_usage() returns only five token fields with no tool-call data
gate runs with REBAR_USAGE_LOG unset record nothing locally, forcing operators to instrument live runs to answer questions that should be queryable from durable logs
the loop-tuning advice in docs/llm-framework.md is unactionable without spend data because nothing tells an operator whether high recursion is paying for a loop or breadth
